feature: Stable permission and guardrail selection layout

cases.title: Keyboard and hover selection preserve every label row
preconditions: Real Prompt mounted as permission or guardrail at fixed width 50 or 100
stimulus: Navigate down through wraparound then up
Hover Allow once then Allow for this session

oracles.expected: Title, body, Choose and all option labels keep the same terminal line indices
Navigation emits no decision; Enter emits exactly always

negative: No label moves when highlight changes
determinism: Explicit frame rendering; no provider calls
platforms: legacy arrows and mouse in neighboring test

cases.title: Escape retains rejection behavior after navigation
preconditions: Same mounted Prompt and recorded decisions as APR-001
stimulus: Press Escape using unambiguous Kitty encoding
determinism: Fixed input encoding avoids legacy Escape timeout
